concepts.name: Electric current
concepts.summary: Electric current is the flow of electric charge through a conductor.
concepts.quote: Electric current is the flow of electric charge through a conductor.

concepts.name: Potential difference (voltage)
concepts.summary: Potential difference is the energy transferred to or from each coulomb of charge as it moves between two points.
concepts.quote: Potential difference (voltage) between two points is the energy transferred to or from each coulomb of charge as it moves between those points.

concepts.name: Resistance
concepts.summary: Resistance is the opposition of a component or wire to the flow of electric current.
concepts.quote: Resistance is the opposition of a component or wire to the flow of electric current.

concepts.name: Ohm’s law
concepts.summary: Ohm's law links potential difference, current, and resistance using the relationship V = I × R.
concepts.quote: Ohm’s law states that V = I × R, where V is the potential difference in volts, I is the current in amperes and R is the resistance in ohms.

concepts.name: Series circuits
concepts.summary: In a series circuit, components are connected end-to-end so there is only one path for electric current.
concepts.quote: In a series circuit the components are connected one after another, so there is only one path for the charge to follow.
